title: Evolving Dark Energy Is Vacuum Energy After All (Lee, van de Bruck, Di Valentino, Van Waerbeke, Zhitnitsky)
efc_relevance: First comprehensive cosmological implementation of dark energy as a non-perturbative QCD-vacuum response to an expanding spacetime — no new fundamental field, no propagating DOF, the late-time evolution emerges from a global vacuum effect. Strong ontological parallel to EFC's 'no new field, geometry-from-entropy' stance, but routes through the QCD topological-charge sector rather than EFC's S(r,t) entropy-flow. Fit against Planck+ACT+SPT-3G + DESI DR2 + Pantheon+/DES-Dovekie — exactly the same combined-CMB + Stage-IV baseline EFC must match.
